title: Portfolio Uplift Ladder Printed Against Each Vending Services Program Programme
content:
Every programme of the Vending Services Program carries a threshold ladder mapping the number of machines the client hosts to an uplift on the commission percentage. Each ladder has four steps, printed at 1, 5, 12 and 25 machines hosted, and the uplift printed at each step is a percentage.

| Programme | Uplift at the step of 1 machine | Uplift at the step of 5 machines | Uplift at the step of 12 machines | Uplift at the step of 25 machines |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | 0.00 | 0.50 | 1.00 | 1.50 |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | 0.00 | 0.75 | 1.25 | 1.75 |
| Combination Vending Bank | 0.00 | 1.00 | 1.75 | 2.50 |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | 0.00 | 1.25 | 2.00 | 2.75 |
| Campus Vending Network Service | 0.00 | 1.50 | 2.50 | 3.50 |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | 0.00 | 1.75 | 3.00 | 4.25 |

The ladder steps stand at the same four machine counts on all six programmes; what differs between programmes is the uplift printed at each step.

### The same ladders read step by step

At the step of 1 machine the uplift is 0.00 on every programme in the schedule. At the step of 5 machines it runs from 0.50 on the Single Machine Snack Service up to 1.75 on the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service. At the step of 12 machines it runs from 1.00 up to 3.00 across the same two programmes, and at the step of 25 machines from 1.50 up to 4.25. Within each programme the uplift rises with the step: on the Campus Vending Network Service, for instance, the four figures are 0.00, 1.50, 2.50 and 3.50.

### What the figure at a step is

An uplift is an addition to the commission percentage and is itself expressed in percentage points, not a share of the commission. Because the uplift printed at the first step is 0.00 on all six programmes, a ladder read at that step leaves the commission percentage printed against the programme unchanged. Any uplift above 0.00 raises it: on the Combination Vending Bank, where the uplift at the step of 12 machines is 1.75, the ladder read at that step adds 1.75 percentage points to the commission percentage printed against that programme.
